Greenwood Capital Associates Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 33.28% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Greenwood Capital Associates Llc sold 18,335 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 36,766 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.17 million, down from 55,101 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greenwood Capital Associates Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $943.12B market cap company. The stock increased 0.78% or $1.48 during the last trading session, reaching $191.88. About 16.74 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since July 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 EPS, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76B for 21.90 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78 % negative EPS growth.
